matches.rationale: F01 specifies a one-time scheduled coaching session attached to a routine primary-care visit with no ongoing coaching relationship. S03 matches this exactly by framing the chat as a single visit-linked consultation that ends without further scheduled sessions.

F02 describes a drop-in remote coaching service the patient can return to as needed, without fixed cadence or continuity with the same coach. S01 explicitly opens as a portal-based drop-in service and repeatedly notes Alex may or may not come back later.

F03 is the only configuration with a structured multi-week program, recurring check-ins, and the same assigned digital coach over time. S02 clearly reflects this ongoing program through scheduled follow-ups, references to prior sessions, and plans for future check-ins with the same coach.
